type_en: carved toad on lotus leaf, mounted on carved base
visual_en: Opaque butterscotch-yellow amber carving of a warty toad sitting on a lotus leaf, with natural brown crust left along the leaf edges; the leaf is raised on a gilt metal post above a second carved amber block (lotus pod) as base.
notes_en: Folder checked: 6 views of one mounted object (toad/leaf and carved base belong together).

visual_en: Opaque butterscotch amber carving of a rat clutching a large textured peanut shell, its long tail curled along the body.
notes_en: Folder checked: one object. #136 (DUPS "fd (9) (1).jpg") is a pixel-identical copy of #135.

visual_en: Opaque butterscotch amber goldfish with carved scales and pierced, flowing fins and tail; no base.
notes_en: Folder checked: one object. DUPS #140 and #141 are copies of #139, #143 is a copy of #142 (distance 0). Different object from the translucent goldfish on a base Amb-dec-021 (S31).

type_en: carved eagle standing on a bear
visual_en: Opaque butterscotch amber group of an eagle with half-raised wings standing with its talons on the head of a crouching bear; the single photo is a two-view composite (front and back).
notes_en: Folder checked: one photo, one object.

visual_en: Opaque butterscotch amber carving of a Chinese cabbage (bok choy) with ruffled, veined leaves and a cricket/katydid resting on top.
notes_en: Folder checked: one object. #149 (DUPS "fd (18) (1).jpg") is a copy of #148.

visual_en: Opaque butterscotch amber group of a boy holding up a goat by its forelegs, on a base with natural crust edge; the single photo is a two-view composite (front and back).
notes_en: Folder checked: one photo, one object.

visual_en: Rounded polished pebble of opaque reddish-orange (cognac-cherry) amber with fine crazing over the whole surface and small patches of rough brown crust at the ends. #151 is a four-view composite of the same stone.
notes_en: K&A item, classified ST (natural nugget, only polished). The crazing looks like normal ageing/oxidation of old amber. Not found among the S09/S31 pebbles.

type_en: enamelled goblet with amber stem and matching amber mouthpiece (cased set)
visual_en: Cobalt-blue enamelled cup with gilt lambrequin/tassel decoration on a turned opaque cherry-red amber stem with carved bone collars and a blue-and-white enamelled foot; beside it a matching amber mouthpiece with cobalt enamel collars, and a brown gilt-tooled leather fitted case behind.
notes_en: Single photo; goblet, mouthpiece and case are shown together as one cased set, so one piece. Material unsure: the opaque cherry-red stem/mouthpiece could be natural cherry amber or old phenolic "cherry amber" (faturan). The function of the set is not clear (possibly parts of a smoking set/hookah).

type_en: cased meerschaum pipe with amber mouthpiece
visual_en: Long pipe in its fitted case with tan lining: meerschaum bowl carved with a quartered coat of arms (birds and lions, close-up #155), dark wooden stem sections, opaque butterscotch-orange amber mouthpiece and a green silk tassel cord.
notes_en: #155 is a close-up of the bowl seen in #154 (same scratches, same yellow cord).

visual_en: Closed fitted case in black grained leather, shaped like a bent pipe (S-curve), worn at the edges; the contents are not shown.
notes_en: Only the closed case is photographed. It may be the case of a pipe photographed elsewhere (the S02 #12-#14 bent meerschaum pipe also has a black leather case) but this could not be confirmed, so it is kept separate.

visual_en: Boxy raw nugget with oxidised orange-red skin, a flat top and several narrow slot-shaped cavities on the front (one long vertical slot and an L-shaped horizontal one); shown on a dark wooden disc stand.
notes_en: K&A item, classified ST. Grouping unsure: #161 (see g2-12) might show this stone instead.

type_en: raw amber nugget with polished window
visual_en: Tall raw nugget with dark brown crust in vertical bands over orange amber, a long dark fissure just below the top, and a small cut window at the top showing pale cream amber with flow lines (close-up #158).
notes_en: K&A item, classified ST. #158 matches the top window of #159 (same pale flow lines and blue-green streaks). #161 (on a tall brass stand) shows a boxy stone with a fissure along the top and dark crust with a large pocket on one half; it fits this stone seen from its broad side, but it could also be #157 (g2-11). Not certain.

visual_en: Elongated low raw nugget of translucent orange amber with crackled skin, a deep horizontal fissure along its lower third, a small round hole and dark crust at one end; on a dark wooden disc stand.
notes_en: K&A item, classified ST. Shape (long and low) does not match the other S15 stones.

type_en: raw amber nugget with polished window
visual_en: Large layered raw nugget with thick ochre-brown weathered crust and horizontal growth layers; one side is opened to a polished window of pale cream to yellow opaque amber (#163, close-up #165).
notes_en: K&A item, classified ST.

type_en: natural amber nugget fitted with a brooch pin
visual_en: Natural nugget with one face polished flat (translucent honey-orange with cloudy zones) and the rest left as ribbed rough crust; a long brass pin fitting with catch is fixed to the polished face.
notes_en: Folder checked: 6 photos of one object (polished face with fitting #166/#167/#169, crust face #168, side and top #170/#171). Category unsure: because of the pin fitting it could be treated as a brooch/mounted piece (A); kept ST as the owner filed it.

visual_en: Elongated polished nugget of translucent honey-to-cognac amber lying on its side, with dark mossy (dendritic) debris inclusions and rough crust pockets.
notes_en: K&A item, classified ST. Grouping unsure: shot 9 minutes before #173 and may be the same stone as g2-17 seen lying down; not confirmed.

type_en: polished natural amber nugget with inclusions
visual_en: Upright, roughly triangular polished nugget of transparent cognac amber full of sun-spangle discs, dark debris and crust pockets, crossed by a long straight diagonal crack (close-up #174).
notes_en: K&A item, classified ST.

visual_en: Polished golden-honey translucent nugget with greyish-white crust left in pockets and sparkling inclusions; #175 shows it lying, #176 and #177 upright.
notes_en: K&A item, classified ST.

visual_en: Rectangular hinged box veneered all over with amber mosaic of hexagonal and irregular tiles in butterscotch, honey and cognac; maroon velvet lining and metal hinge.
notes_en: Not the same as the mosaic boxes in S09/S31.

visual_en: Necklace of graduated irregular, faceted cognac amber nuggets alternating with silver beads, with an ornate silver clasp set with a red stone.
Single strand of graduated olive-shaped butterscotch/egg-yolk amber beads with cream marbling, two large beads at the front, gold-tone spring-ring clasp.
notes_en: Different strand from the S21/S24/S25 necklaces.

visual_en: Close-up of smooth oval beads of very dark cherry-brown, almost black, on a white background; the whole strand is not shown.
notes_en: Only a close-up exists. Material unsure (very dark cherry amber or resin/faturan). Not the S25 cherry strand (beads darker and more opaque).

visual_en: Opaque orange-butterscotch amber carving of an eagle/falcon perched on a rocky outcrop; the single photo is a two-view composite.
notes_en: Folder checked: one photo, one object.

type_en: bronze moose on amber mosaic base
visual_en: Patinated dark bronze/spelter moose standing on a rectangular base veneered with faceted butterscotch-honey amber tiles.
notes_en: Not the same as S05 #36 (golden moose on red carved base) or S31 #390/#391 (moose on cognac mosaic base).

visual_en: Square stand veneered with butterscotch and cognac amber tiles in a stepped frame, with a silvered metal square tray, an attached matchbox holder and a small cup.
notes_en: Not the ashtray of the S04 #34 desk set.

visual_en: Letter rack with three graduated chrome arches on a rectangular base faced with hexagonal tiles of swirled orange amber.
notes_en: Material unsure: the uniform, swirled tiles look like pressed amber (ambroid).

type_en: cased pair of amber mouthpieces / cheroot holders
visual_en: Long tapering black tooled-leather case (#190, closed) with cream lining holding a pair of opaque cherry-orange amber mouthpieces with bulbous ends and long thin stems.
notes_en: #189 "DSC_8912 (1).jpg" is a pixel-identical copy of #190. Material unsure: the opaque cherry-orange colour could be natural amber or faturan.

type_en: cased set of amber pendants (acorns and gnome heads)
visual_en: Fitted box with cream silk lining holding seven pendants: faceted transparent cognac amber acorns with natural acorn cups, carved butterscotch gnome heads in acorn caps, and a central butterscotch drop with a small acorn.
notes_en: Shown as a fitted set, so one piece.

visual_en: Strand of about 35 graduated polished olive beads in egg-yolk, butterscotch and orange with cream swirls on red string, the largest bead in the centre.
notes_en: Different strand from #182 and from the S24/S25 strands.

visual_en: Necklace of polished free-form amber nuggets in butterscotch, honey and transparent cognac, graduating to a large butterscotch drop at the front, knotted on yellow cord with a screw clasp.
notes_en: #195 "jj (60) (1).jpg" is a copy of #196 (distance 0). #196-#198 are close-ups.

type_en: amber flower necklace and bracelet set
visual_en: Modern set: flower-cluster pendant of butterscotch and honey amber chips on a multi-strand black cord with dangling amber drops, and a matching flower-cluster bracelet on black cords.
notes_en: Necklace (#199-#201) and bracelet (#202) are shown together in #203, so one set piece.

visual_en: Rectangular cut and polished block of transparent red-cognac amber with a swirling flow structure and dark elongated debris inclusions; photographed on black and backlit on white.
notes_en: A cut block, not made into an object, so it stays ST. Material unsure: the very even swirl pattern could mean pressed/reconstructed amber.

visual_en: Long holder with a butterscotch-orange amber mouthpiece with ringed collar, a grey-mottled middle section and a cognac amber end, in its blue-lined fitted case stamped "JOSEF OSTERMANN" (#210).
Stretch bracelet of flat round polished discs in swirled orange and cognac.
notes_en: Material unsure: the swirled, very uniform colour suggests pressed amber or resin.

type_en: cased meerschaum pipe with amber stem
visual_en: Meerschaum pipe with silver bands and a bowl carved with a monogram cartouche on a pierced ground, swirled cognac amber stem, in a burgundy fitted case lined with blue silk printed "FEINSTE QUALITÄT".
notes_en: Not the melusine pipe of the clipping #239.

visual_en: Long strand of olive-shaped butterscotch/egg-yolk amber beads with heavy cream marbling, including two dark cognac beads; photographed on white.
notes_en: Different strand from the deep-orange one in S25 (g2-38).

visual_en: Strand of oval translucent cherry-red beads with mottled, crackled interiors; photographed on white and on black.
notes_en: #227 "DSC_6121 (1).jpg" is a copy of #228. Material unsure: heat-treated cherry amber or faturan (phenolic "cherry amber").

visual_en: Long strand of graduated olive beads in opaque deep orange and butterscotch with a slightly matt surface; photographed on white.
notes_en: Different strand from #221/#222 and #182.

type_en: carved figure of a bearded old man
visual_en: Opaque orange-butterscotch amber figure of a bearded old man in a hooded coat holding a long-necked gourd/bottle, with a sack on his back; the boots are in a pale grey-white zone.
notes_en: Folder checked: 5 views of one object.

visual_en: Art Deco style chrome-framed square lamp with panels of butterscotch and cognac amber, amber bun feet, a vented chrome top and a white cord with switch.

Paper clipping of auction lot 119, "A meerschaum and amber pipe": bowl carved with a seated melusine, banner "Certavi et Vici O'Byrne", silver mount inscribed "To Mr John Humphries 1914 from John Chisholm", 19 cm, fitted case; with a halftone photo, taped together.
notes_en: A document, not an object. The pipe it describes is not photographed in S12-S30 (and not in S31); attach it to that pipe if it is found elsewhere, otherwise keep it as a supporting document. It is not the S23 pipe (monogram bowl) or the AMB-A-001 pipe.

visual_en: Round dish faced with concentric rings of radiating butterscotch, honey and cognac amber tiles around a silvered metal centre.
notes_en: #240 "DSC_8513 (1).jpg" is a copy of #241. Not the S32 #440/#443 coaster.

type_en: Ottoman/Qajar-style chibouk pipe with amber mouthpiece and painted case
visual_en: Long pipe with a red clay (tophane) bowl in gilt mounts, green velvet-covered stem with enamelled gilt fittings, chains and a crescent pendant, and an orange amber mouthpiece; #242 also shows its blue painted lid with roses and a bird.
notes_en: Amber is only the mouthpiece; stays A.

type_en: meerschaum pipe with gilt mounts and amber stem, in fitted case
visual_en: Pale meerschaum pipe with a gilt pierced-lattice gallery and hinged gilt lid with flower boss (hallmarked), engine-turned gilt ferrule and orange amber stem, in a red velvet fitted case (#245) inside a Boulle-marquetry box (#244).
notes_en: Folder AMB-A-001 checked: #246 and #247 are the same frame (#246 "DSC_3342 (1).jpg" is the duplicate) and #248 is the same pipe, so the folder holds one object (OK). Loose #245 (pipe in its open velvet case, same pierced gilt gallery and flower-boss mount) and #244 (closed Boulle box shot just before) are added to it. Unsure only because #244 shows the box closed.

visual_en: Pear-shaped butterscotch-orange amber knob with cream veining, mounted on an engraved silver tube with niello grape-vine decoration.
notes_en: Function not certain (narghile mouthpiece or handle). Not the S05 #39 filigree holders.

visual_en: Polished butterscotch-yellow pebble with cream marbling, one dark crusty groove running diagonally across a face and rough crust at one end; #258 is a four-view composite.
notes_en: Probable re-shoot of K&A stone #71-#74 (S09, 2021-08-22, outside my range): same shape, marbling and diagonal crust groove. Merge with that piece if the S09 group agrees; only my own photos are listed here.

visual_en: Elongated polished pebble of orange and butterscotch amber with pale cream flow patterns and two rows of dark crusty pits and cracks along its length; #253 shows both faces.
notes_en: #256 "DSC_4496 (1).jpg" is a copy of #257. #254 (side view) is assigned by shot order and not fully confirmed. Not the S09 #95-#97 pebble.

visual_en: Gilt-metal flip-top table lighter with the body clad in faceted chunks of cognac and honey amber.
notes_en: Not the S31 #342/#343 lighter.
